name: Rocket Garage
generation_chain: L1 generated from style reference; L2 edited selected L1; L3 edited selected L2. Initial L3 retained as rocket-l3-first.png. Two authorized built-in framing edits; second selected as rocket-l3.png.

levels.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent isometric building sprite for an interactive Cancel City neighbourhood. NEW illustration. Reference portrait is STYLE ONLY: match its bold grotesque punk comic black ink outlines, dense scratchy crosshatching, distressed screen-printed vivid colour, textured hand-drawn details. Show ONE complete building, detached, centered, full structure visible, three-quarter isometric view from diagonally above, orthographic game camera, vertical walls upright. Two visible front/side faces meet at center; ground base is a small diamond-like isometric square. Use the same approximately 30-degree isometric view for all assets. Frame comfortably inside a square canvas with clear transparent margin, preserve room above roof. Include ONLY the building and its own narrow ground footprint, no street, no sky, no background scenery, no large shadow extending outside footprint. TRUE alpha transparent background, not white or checkerboard painted background. NO card frame, UI, captions, readable text, watermark or real logos. High detail at least 1024 square; legible silhouette at 250px. Level 1 starting building, compact and modest but expressive. Palette: acid lime-silver. Subject: An acid-lime industrial rocket garage with patched grey corrugated steel, one silver retro rocket with red nose poking through its open roof, scaffolding, green exposed pipes, a little neon zigzag chart icon over a plain shutter door, welding sparks, tiny tool boxes and cracked lime pavement. Satirize overpromising tech/crypto launches. No brands or readable lettering.
levels.notes: Complete visible garage, rocket, and pavement diamond with clear margin. Very faint generator alpha noise extends beyond visible subject; preserved without alteration.
